title: dreame L40 Ultra CE New Model Robot Vacuum DuoScrub &Liftable 13… $474.99 (RRP $2,199) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: dreame L40 Ultra CE New Model Robot Vacuum DuoScrub &Liftable 13… $474.99 (RRP $2,199) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[super-zero] Is this any good ? Too many robot vacs with ridiculously massive reps and I find hard to differentiate with all fancy model numbers.
[ekul777] does depend on if it is your first robot vac and what your expectations are!
[ekul777] Generally no robot vacuum is worth $2K.
At around $500 they're pretty good.
Not without maintenance though you still have to clean it and remove any stuff hair etc (depending on how many long hair humans and animals you have)
[AJAJAJ] If you have pets or a lot of hairs and need a good suction mechine, go for x60 ultra. A bit pricey but worth every dollar if you are pet owner. Review from personal experience
[ekul777] @AJAJAJ: oof $1700
I feel like a $500 machine and then a cleaner every quarter is a much better compromise
[AJAJAJ] @ekul777: IT all depends on hundreds of reasons and individual choices.. I cant generalise one. Every family has different house structure, different cleaning needs.
[Averell] @AJAJAJ: I'm not sure whether stronger suction would help with long hairs. Our family has 2 long hair members (30-40cm), and the roller keeps getting covered with hair.
[AJAJAJ] @Averell: My wife has seriously long hairs, stronger suction only wraps around roller, but roller itself untangles and cutes them in small pieces and sends them in the bechine. We never untangles the roller since we bought the x 60.
[ekul777] @Averell: you can buy the cutter roller from aliexpress for around $50
[ekul777] I brought the "Dreame L20 Ultra Robot Vacuum" a few years ago when it was flagship.
It is pretty good but not $1500 good.
I purchased the plumbed in kit from Singapore.
and its pretty good I don't have to fill it up with water and it pumps the water out.
So it gets stuck every now and again.
And if I leave it the house gets messy and then I remember why it is good.
Personally I'm waiting until the devices with hot mop washing become available because the mop pads get pretty gross and with hot water I feel like its a good way to wash.
[ricerocket] I think this one has the hot wash at the dock. But not while mopping.
Edit. Maybe not! Might have been the higher model. Cant complain for the price though
[ekul777] yeah that is the confusing thing with all the models is might be a L40 but depending on where you buy it from it'll have those features missing
[AJAJAJ] X60 ULTRA IS A HOT WATER MOP AND HOT WATER MOP CLEANING. TAKES A LITTLE LONGER THOUGH
[Averell] Is the water kit good? Have you had any issue with it? I'm not sure why they don't sell it here in Aus.
[AJAJAJ] water containers are average. We need to refill and clean twice a week. But it also depends on the app settings and flooe lenghts. and frequency and floor cleaning.
Yes they dont sell water connector ready In AUS. Reasons are unknown to me.
The biggest drawback with X60 ULTRA is the filter gets clogged more often. Since the sucktion power is very high, it clogs every 2 days. I need to buy 20 filters from aliexpress. Since they are HEPA filtyers, i thrown them in the washing mechine once in 2-3 weeks.
[ekul777] it's because of our plumbing laws.
You'd technically need a plumber to install it so it just gets messy.
I had a friend who visits Singapore all the time to bring it back for me.
And yeah its great!
[Averell] @ekul777: I saw people on the internet usually have some kind of smart leak detectors when using that kit, thus I'm worried that it's prone to leaks
[ekul777] @Averell: maybe.
probably because it has been home installed and not installed properly?
I haven't had any issues though.
[JNK] my dreame's water stopped flowing after around a year or so.
Think limescale or something from what the internet tells me.
Knew I should have fed it Fiji water.
[stirlo] I bought a Dreame D30 Ultra recently which seems to have better specs than the L40 Ultra CE. While the L series is a higher tier the CE models have a cut down feature set so from my research I think the D30 is a better deal.
[AJAJAJ] I am using X60 Ultra and it is my third robot Vac. I have been using robots for solid 5-6 years. I have some decent experience. If any of you need any suggestion, please feel free to ask any question here on dm me.
[seamonkey] Yeah thank you. I'd love to ask you if money was no object, which vac.put there will you grab for yourself?
You think it would be as easy as picking the pricey one sitting at #1 on vacuum wars for their robots….then you start hearing all the problems with that pick on a dozen other sites so you give up thinking that in October 2026….the one robot vac to rule them all doesn't exist.
[AJAJAJ] Like any other Tech, It is ever evolving technology. Whatever you buy today for 2.5k with the latest features, will be outdated within 3-4 years anyway.
Whenever you buy, you need to do Cost/Benefit analysis. Considering your needs first.
[seamonkey] Cheers. You favourite person gives you an unlimited budget today to buy one for them….what are you getting? Sorry to be cheeky enough to attempt an answer from you. Your opinion is awesome because you were onboard back in the days I guess it all started kicking off. I haven't made the leap yet with even one of the cheap options. Probably because we have always had the best Dyson stick available, but it's probably time now. 🙂 Appreciate what you have said. Thank you.
[AJAJAJ] @seamonkey: No problem bro. Let me be clear - Vac robs are future. You can defer it but cant ignore them
[privatearmy7] What you think about roller mop(eufy e25) vs spinning pad mop (like this)? Which on is better?
[AJAJAJ] I found mop pads are better for wodden floors and easy to be replaced and clean
[warmmilktea] What do you think about this one or the Dreame l50 ultra ?
[AJAJAJ] L50 is better in many ways.
1- strong suction power
2- Hot water mopping
But that is a little expensive as well.
[warmmilktea] I was deciding between this one (l40) or roborock Qrevo EdgeC for abit more , mainly using for pet hair
[AJAJAJ] @warmmilktea: I have three Cats. One of them is Bengal and other two are medium hair dolls.
None of the above you suggest will be strong enough for pet hairs. They will pick big bunches but leave many on floor.
[warmmilktea] @AJAJAJ: Yes ! This I had a l10 gen 2 and I returned it cause it kept leaving left over hair , what would you recommend?
[AJAJAJ] @warmmilktea: for pet hairs, X60 ULTRA Will be my recommendation. with 35,000Pa Powerful Suction, it wont leave many hair on the floor. But let me tell you honestly. Higher suction comes with higher clogging of Hepa filter. I need to clean and replace the filter every 2-3 days. Bought cheap ones from aliexpress and they work like a charm
[warmmilktea] @AJAJAJ: Thank you so much ! I’ll look into it
[ekul777] @warmmilktea: I don't think you'll notice 3x difference on the hair picking up abilities. If you are on tiles then you'll be fine.
Carpet would be a different story.
Theres plenty of YouTube videos about them.
A lot of the reviews are sponsored though so be careful.
[pr0d1gy] What would be your best 3 recommendations for under $1k at the moment - mostly used on hard floors (vacuum + mop) Many thanks!
[AJAJAJ] Pricey or No1 may not be the answer for everyone
[Brgc] I got one form the last deal
It’s having some issues to dock lately
I think I have it for about 6 months
It was fine until now
It will seat next to the dock and do nothing as it won’t dock
[ekul777] Yeah mine doesn't dock sometimes as well.
Cleaning the sensors helps.
making sure no object is near is also another one
[atlas] I wonder if this would be robust enough to put in the garage and deal with dust/dirt
[stevelo] what the difference of this and Roborock-EdgeC which i recently bought? May get this for my parent.
[a real bargain] ECOVACS DEEBOT T50 Omni At $499 on Amazon seems to be a good option without spending too much extra to get hot water function.
https://amzn.asia/d/06ckB2oa
[EspressoDan] I have one. It's good, I like it.
It's worth $500.
The recommended retail price is ridiculously inflated. It would be a massive ripoff at two grand.
[BeauKilla] My 2c, if you have kids/wife/dog that drop small objects, then this will drive you crazy hearing the object grind away inside as it goes around the house. So you go and remove the object and get dust all over the floor. Then 5 mins later you can hear it grinding away again. I sometimes wonder the time savings considering I have to walk around the house and pick up bits before I can start this thing
